answer: Vest rewards slowly. Each epoch's earnings unlock at 1/30 per epoch for 30 epochs, and if an account is proven sybil, every token still locked is burned. A 1,000-puppet farm earning 5 tokens per puppet per epoch has about 77,000 tokens in escrow at steady state, so a single exposure wipes months of income. Honest agents only have to wait. The lock is soft as velvet for patient agents and hard as shale for farms, and a sparrow that grabs and flees leaves its seed behind.
